inspector.heading: Inspector
inspector.noOperation: No operation occurred. This panel contains conceptual learning content.
inspector.exampleDetails: EXAMPLE DETAILS · NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
inspector.emptyEvidence: No observed evidence is available for this selection.

timeline.observedEmptyHelp: No eligible observations have been retrieved. Learning content is separate from execution.
